revised_hypotheses: Vandetanib's A375 histone-mark profile may reflect kinase-inhibitor pharmacology rather than direct chromatin-modifying activity.
Trametinib, lapatinib, and axitinib are supported as kinase-inhibitor reference donors by retrieved pharmacology descriptions.
CPI-169 and BIX-01294 remain mechanistically relevant to H3K27/H3K9 marks but lack retrieved pharmacology descriptions supporting their use.
unresolved: No measured histone-mark response values for vandetanib or donors in A375.
Retrieved sources for CPI-169 and BIX-01294 describe chemistry only, not chromatin-modifier pharmacology.
Whether kinase-inhibitor donors reproduce vandetanib's anchor histone-mark signature is untested.
